name: Wetlands for Wildlife Grants
summary: Annual grants to restore, enhance and create wetlands and riparian areas in Colorado. Non-profit habitat groups, tribes, local governments and companies can apply; private landowners cannot apply directly.
reporting: Quarterly project updates to the CPW Wetlands Program Coordinator until completion, plus a final project report on completion.

steps: Application to the Wetlands Program Coordinator
Completeness screening, scoring and committee ranking

eligibility.rule: Has no active project from a past grant that has fallen behind its stated delivery schedule
No habitat acquisition, water rights, mitigation-project, or equipment purchase costs except permitted pumps
Lists a CPW Project Sponsor on the application

status.quote: Applications are closed. The next round of grant applications is expected to open in February 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Local governments, other state and federal land management agencies, tribes, non-profit habitat conservation organizations, and private companies.

geography.quote: restore, enhance, and create wetlands and riparian areas in Colorado

access.quote: Check Your Eligibility Eligible Grant Recipients

window.quote: Colorado Parks and Wildlife annually seeks applications for wetland and riparian restoration, enhancement, and creation projects

reporting.quote: Each calendar quarter (March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31) through project completion, the Project Manager must submit a project update

effort.quote: Please contact the Wetlands Program Coordinator before applying (see contact information below).
Applications due to the Wetlands Program Coordinator.
Immediately after the deadline, applications are screened for completeness and adherence to formatting guidelines.
Applications are ranked by CPW regional committees.

eligibility.quote: Previous grant recipients with an active project that has fallen behind schedule relative to the project delivery timeframe identified in the application

Habitat protection through fee title or easement acquisitions. Acquisition of water rights. Any costs associated with wetlands that are part of a mitigation project or bank. Equipment purchases; except pumps are allowed on a case-by-case basis if needed to maintain desired hydrology of a wetland site.
Each application must list a CPW Project Sponsor.

after_award.quote: Each calendar quarter (March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31) through project completion, the Project Manager must submit a project update (electronically) to the CPW Wetlands Program Coordinator.
